_comment: Copy to orderapp-settings.json beside the exe (git-ignored). Standing trade inputs restored at startup; saved automatically on close and via right-click 'Save Trade Defaults' on the MARGINS / AMOUNT($) groups. Missing keys fall back to the Designer defaults. risk_per_trade_usd / max_size_usd drive the SIZE button; circuit_breaker_usd is the persisted max session loss (<= 0 disables; default 10); the alerts block gates the sound/taskbar alerts (all default on).
_comment_ev_chase_budget: EV-aware chase budget (docs/spec-ev-chase-budget.md). min_net_move_pct is a price FRACTION, NOT a percent: 0.0005 = 0.05% = 5 bps. The Tooling box 'Min Net Profit' (the key keeps the older min_net_move name - display-text-only rename) is the only place the value is typed as a percent (0.05 there = 0.0005 here). 0 or less turns the EV floor OFF entirely, which is the shipped default and is byte-identical to the pre-EV app - set a value to enable it. When it binds, a chase in progress is abandoned with 'Working entry cancelled (EV floor)' instead of chasing on to the ATR cap; it only ever applies while a TP target is in force (a manual/bridge TP), never to OFFSET-flow trades. maker_fee_bps / taker_fee_bps are the Deribit schedule effective 2026-08-01 and have no UI: the round-trip fee the budget charges derives as 2 x maker (maker entry + maker TP), and taker_fee_bps sets the DEFAULT COMMS the app writes into the comms box on every index tick (3.5 bps of the index, rounded to whole dollars - so it also moves the derived TP and the break-even trigger). A fee announcement is these two numbers and nothing else.
_comment_risk_size_bridge: Risk-sized bridge trades (docs/spec-risk-sized-bridge-trades.md). SHIPS DISABLED: absent or false means BRIDGE trades take their size from the Amount box exactly as before, which is byte-identical to the pre-N2 app. True sizes each bridge trade as risk_per_trade_usd x entry / |entry - stop| using the ENGINE's own levels, floored to the 10-USD contract step and capped by max_size_usd (a cap of 0 or less means NO cap; a non-step cap is itself floored to the step). If the formula cannot run - no entry in the payload, a zero stop distance, or risk_per_trade_usd <= 0 - it falls back to the Amount box and says so in yellow; a signal is never refused over sizing. The session_policy size_mult below folds onto this as ONE chain, applied exactly once, never stacked. The Amount box must still be non-zero or the payload is refused at the size gate before sizing runs. The manual SIZE button is unaffected by this key. The Tooling checkbox is 'Risk-size', in the SIGNAL BRIDGE group.
_comment_flat_atr: Flat ATR (docs/spec-frmindicators-retirement.md). flat_atr_usd is an ATR in USD, NOT a limit: the entry-side slippage guard (the repositioning cap) uses it ALWAYS when use_flat_atr is true, and as the FALLBACK when no fresh engine ATR exists (engine stopped, stale or stood down). Unticked, the guard takes the engine payload's ATR in EVERY bridge mode, Off included. Either way the cap is ATR x max_slippage_atr_mult (0.6 when that is 0) - so the default 70 gives a 42 USD cap. Must be > 0; a non-positive value is ignored and 70 stands. In the Tooling group as 'Flat ATR' and 'Use flat ATR'.
_comment_session_policy: Per-session trader policy (docs/spec-session-policy-gate.md). A SECOND filter after the contract gate chain - it can only ever NARROW what the global Tiers box already allows, never widen it. enabled=false is today's behaviour exactly, and it arms nothing (bridge Mode/ARM/START are still never persisted). tiers: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW (STRONG and WEAK are accepted as aliases for HIGH and LOW). contexts: the string 'any', or a list of verdict_context identifiers matched exactly - a payload whose context is empty FAILS a non-'any' list, by design. size_mult: (0,1]; 1.0 leaves size untouched, anything less floors the order to the 10-USD contract step and never below 10. An omitted session key means that session runs on the defaults (HIGH,MEDIUM | any | 1.0).
